units.source_text: 岁历更新，匆匆已届三月，藤壶母后周年忌辰过去了，朝野臣民都除去丧服，改穿常装。

en.t: The year had turned anew, and in the rush of days March had already arrived. The first anniversary of Empress Mother Fujitsubo's death had passed, and people throughout the court and the country had put off their mourning clothes and changed back into ordinary dress.

units.source_text: 到了四月一日的更衣节上，满朝衣冠都像花团锦簇一般了。

en.t: By the robe-changing festival on the first day of the fourth month, the garments and caps of the whole court were as splendid as masses of flowers and brocade.

units.source_text: 四月中旬的酉日，举行贺茂祭时，天色也很明朗鲜丽，只有前斋院槿姬依旧孤居寂处，悒悒寡欢。

en.t: On the Day of the Rooster in mid-fourth month, when the Kamo Festival was held, the sky too was bright and vividly clear; only Princess Asagao, the former Kamo priestess, still lived alone in quiet seclusion, melancholy and joyless.

units.source_text: 庭前的桂树蒙着初夏的熏风，欣欣向荣，青青可爱。

en.t: The katsura tree before the garden, touched by the fragrant breeze of early summer, flourished with fresh vigor, green and lovely.

units.source_text: 青年侍女们看见了，都回思小姐当斋院那年举行贺茂祭时的情状，不胜恋恋。

en.t: When the young gentlewomen saw it, they all thought back to the Kamo Festival in the year when their lady had served as priestess, and they could not restrain their longing.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣来信问候说：“今年斋院父丧期满，该除服了。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, sent a letter of inquiry, saying, "This year the priestess's mourning period for her father has ended, so it must be time to put off mourning clothes.

units.source_text: 贺茂祭祓禊之时，心情定然舒畅了吧。”

en.t: At the time of the purification rites for the Kamo Festival, your heart must surely have felt more at ease."
He also sent a poem, saying:
